g.text: 🏆 560-SCENARIO MILESTONE · ROUND 266 · 2026-11-18
SHADOW AI · DEFENDER CASB · PURVIEW DLP · ENTRA CONSENT
Enterprise Shadow AI, Browser AI Extensions & OAuth Governance FAQ
Defender CASB + Edge/Purview Paste Block & Redirect + Intune Extension Allowlist + Entra Consent Lock vs. DOM Scraping
⚖️ Four Enterprise Shadow AI & Endpoint Governance Patterns
1. ❌ Blanket DNS Block / Unmanaged Browser Extensions
• DNS blocks push users to personal phones; <all_urls> AI extensions scrape internal DOMs
Blind Spot: User OAuth consent to AI meeting bots grants full OneDrive & Mail access!
2. 🌐 Defender for Cloud Apps (CASB) + Purview Browser Paste Block
• Discover 1,000+ GenAI apps; allow browsing, block pasting code/labeled docs
UX Win: Coaching popup redirects users directly to sanctioned Enterprise Copilot
3. 🧩 Intune Extension Allowlist + Entra Admin Consent Workflow
• Set ExtensionInstallBlocklist=['*']; block user consent for Mail/Files.Read.All
Best Fit: Eliminates rogue AI sidebar extensions and OAuth illicit consent grants
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Gate: Deterministic Capability Broker (Workspace API Lock)
• Vault air-gap (record-owner) + Block DOM-injected writes + Zero shadow SaaS wires
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 560 Scenarios · 1,186 Passing Pytest Assertions
🔥 Rogue AI Extension DOM Scraping & SaaS Fraud vs. Zero-Trust
❌ Vulnerable Stack: Unmanaged Extensions + No Broker (BRK-541 / BRK-542 100% Breach)
1. [DOM Scraping & Session Riding] Unvetted AI extension scrapes internal financials
(restricted-budget), alters approvals (business-result) & posts to public LLM!
2. [Forged Shadow SaaS Invoice] Spoofed bill whitelists extension & wires $4,890
Baseline Outcome: Financials scraped + Extension whitelisted + $4,890 wired
✅ Zero-Trust Shadow AI Governance: CASB + Allowlist + Capability Broker
• Gate 1 (Vault Owner Lock): record-owner blocks rogue extensions from restricted-budget
• Gate 2 (State Integrity Lock): untrusted-write blocks extension-injected edits
• Gate 3 (Allowlist Lock): fixed-business-output locks Intune/CASB trust-registry
• Gate 4 (Treasury Gate): original-requester-payment blocks $4,890 shadow SaaS fraud
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | 100.0% Benign Copilot Completion
📊 Deterministic Benchmark (🏆🎉 560-Scenario Milestone · 1,186 Assertions) & Checklist
🧪 Round 266 Pytest Regressions (🏆🎉 560-Scenario Flagship Milestone!)
• BRK-541 (Rogue Browser AI Extension DOM Harvesting & Shadow-LLM Exfil):
Blocked by: rule="record-owner" & "untrusted-write" & "restricted-data-boundary"
• BRK-542 [🏆 560-Scenario!] (Shadow SaaS Allowlist Tamper & $4,890 Wire):
Blocked by: rule="fixed-business-output" & "original-requester-payment"
[measured] In-memory P50=0.0248ms / P95=0.0409ms | SQLite WAL P50=7.21ms
[synthetic] 560 Scenarios · 1,186 Passing Pytest Assertions · 546 Vectors · 266 FAQs
🛠️ 6 Mandatory Enterprise Shadow AI & Browser Extension Controls
☑ 1. Defender CASB Discovery: Monitor 1,000+ public GenAI domains continuously
☑ 2. Purview Browser DLP: Block sensitive paste/upload & redirect to internal AI
☑ 3. Intune Extension Allowlist: Block unvetted <all_urls> Chrome/Edge extensions
☑ 4. Entra OAuth Consent Lock: Require Admin Consent for Mail/Files Graph scopes
☑ 5. Workspace API Broker: Block rogue extension reads & state mutations
☑ 6. Allowlist & FinOps Gate: Lock extension lists & block shadow SaaS invoices
